title: Lovely Bike ride and tour of Barcelona
text: We had a wonderful bike trip with Stephanie.  She is bright, energetic and full of knowledge of and love for Barcelona.  We learned so much from her and enjoyed ourselves. Stephanie is also kind, friendly and extremely likable.  We highly recommend this tour.
author: slovinr

title: Comfy bikes and a fun way to see the city!
text:
Our tour with Andrei was, in a word, fun! As a knowledgeable and enthusiastic guide, he navigated us effortlessly through the bustling Barcelona streets, bringing the city’s history to life in a way that no textbook ever could.
One of the highlights was his intimate knowledge of Antoni Gaudí. Andrei illuminated us with many intriguing details about Gaudi's personal life, including little-known anecdotes about his relationship with the bourgeoisie and his unique vision of the city. These details were not something you would typically find in official guidebooks or on the internet.

author: ianireu2022

title: Best way to see the city!!
text: Andrei took us on our bike tour and he was amazing!!!  He was able to give us a great tour, tell us some history about Barcelona, and keep a pace that we could all stay together, without going too fast or too slow.   We had time to ask questions and really got a great feel for the city and its layout.  I usually do a double decker bus tour, but this was even better!!!  My entire family enjoyed it (ages 62, 59, 21, 20).
author: 640susies

title: Brilliant guided tour
text: The cycle tour was probably the highlight of my weekend in Barcelona! I’ve never done one before and will definitely look them up in other cities now . We covered a lot of ground and Andrei was very knowledgeable on the history of the town and even had a folder of visual material .  The city has fantastic cycle lanes and dedicated traffic lights so it felt very safe.  I would recommend and so would my two friends.
author: AlisonS168
